contexts.text: I will set up My covenant with thee () = that he would be regenerated; for no covenant can come between God and man, except conjunction through love and faith; thus covenant = conjunction; for it is the heavenly marriage, which is the veriest covenant; and this has no existence except with those who are being regenerated; so that regeneration itself is signified by covenant in the widest sense. The Lord enters into a covenant with man when He regenerates him; wherefore, with the ancients, a covenant represented nothing else. AC 1023.
Hence the covenants so often made with the sons of Jacob were nothing but representative rituals. AC 4290:4.

That a covenant = nothing but regeneration, and the things belonging to regeneration, may be evident from the Word throughout, where the Lord Himself is called the covenant, because He alone is the One who regenerates, and Who is regarded by a regenerate man, and is the All in all of love and faith. Illustrated.
In , the Lord is called the Angel of the covenant.
The Sabbath is called an eternal covenant (), because it = the Lord Himself.

As the Lord is the real covenant itself, it is evident that to the covenant belongs everything which conjoins man with the Lord, thus love and faith, and the things of love and faith; for these are the Lord's, and the Lord is in them; thus the real covenant is in them. These things, however, do not exist except with the regenerate, with whom whatever is the Regenerator's is of the covenant, or is the covenant. Illustrated.
The ark, book, and blood of the covenant = the Lord. AC 4735:7. AC 4735:10.
I set up My covenant () = the Lord's presence in charity. AC 1032. AC 1039. AC 1044.
To set up a covenant () = the conjunction of the Lord with men in the universe through love.

This is the sign of the covenant () = a mark of the Lord's presence in charity... This is evident from the nature of a covenant; for every covenant is for the sake of conjunction, that they may live in friendship or in love; hence marriage is called a covenant... This is the veriest essence of a covenant... AC 1059.

As a covenant = the conjunction of the Lord with man through love, or, what is the same, the presence of the Lord with man in love and charity, the real covenant is called in the Word the covenant of peace. Illustrated.
As a covenant = the conjunction of the Lord with man through love, it = conjunction through all things which are of love, which are the truths of faith, and are called commandments...
Hence a covenant is an internal thing...
That external things are not a covenant, unless internal ones are joined to them... but are signs of a covenant... Hence the Sabbath, and circumcision, are called signs of the covenant. Illustrated.
The nature of this covenant, explained.
I will remember My covenant which is between Me and between you () = the Lord's mercy, in special, towards the regenerate and those who can be regenerated.
To remember the covenant of eternity () = that the Lord may be present with him in charity... No covenant is eternal except love to the Lord, and love towards the neighbour.
When man can be regenerate, or be restored again to order, and can receive mutual love, there is then the covenant or conjunction through charity which is here treated of.
In that day Jehovah made a covenant with Abram () = the conjunction of the Lord's interior man with His internal one. A covenant = conjunction. AC 1996.
Jehovah never makes a covenant with man... AC 2842.
Behold, My covenant is with thee () = the union of the Divine essence with the Human one. Covenant = conjunction.
I will set up My covenant between Me and between thee () = union. Covenant = union.
Covenant = conjunction. AC 2719. AC 2720:6. AC 3452.
Thou shalt keep My covenant () = union still closer. Covenant = union and conjunction. The repetition of the word covenant = closer conjunction.

This is My covenant, which ye shall keep between Me and between you () = a mark of the conjunction of all things with the Lord. A covenant = conjunction; here, a mark of conjunction, as is evident from the following verse, where it is called a sign of the covenant. The signs of the covenant were all the outward rites of the Church...

My covenant shall be in your flesh () = the conjunction of the Lord with man in his impurity. Covenant = conjunction. AC 2054. AC 4197:3, References. AC 7195. AC 8495. AC 9391:18. AC 9416:2. AR 466:end. AE 388:27. AE 391:16.
He hath made void My covenant () = that it cannot be conjoined.

I will set up My covenant with him into an eternal covenant () = eternal union. Covenant = conjunction; and when predicated of the Lord, the union of His Divine essence with His Human one, and of the Human one with the Divine.
I will set up my covenant with Isaac () = union with the Divine Rational.
To make a covenant () regards Divine good; to swear, Divine truth.
Covenant is predicated of what is celestial.
Hence it is not said that they made a covenant with Isaac... because covenant is predicated of good.
A new covenant () = conjunction with the Lord through good.
Let us make a covenant, I and thou () = the conjunction of the Divine Natural with the goods of works.
Heaps were used by the ancients as a... witness that there a covenant had been made.
The commandments of the decalogue were called the testimony, because they were of a covenant, thus of conjunction between the Lord and man... Illustrated.
God remembered His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob () = on account of conjunction with the Church through the Lord's Divine Human. AC 7195. AC 7200.

That covenant = conjunction, may be evident from the covenants between kingdoms, for they are thereby conjoined; and from their being stipulations by each side which are to be kept, in order that the conjunction may be maintained; these stipulations or compacts are also called a covenant. Those which in the Word are called a covenant, are, on man's side, in a confined sense, the ten commandments; in a wider sense, all the statutes, etc., which the Lord enjoined from Sinai; and in a still wider sense, the books of Moses... On the Lord's side they are mercy and choice. (All these points illustrated in succession.)
A covenant = conjunction through love and faith. Illustrated.
There were also signs of a covenant in the representative Church. Illustrated.

If ye shall keep My covenant () = life in good, and thence conjunction. To keep the covenant = to live according to the commandments, thus in good, and so to be conjoined with the Lord... For the articles of the covenant were all things that were commanded... The reason to keep the covenant also = to be conjoined, is that by covenant in the universal sense, is signified conjunction. References.

As covenants are to be made by consent on both sides, Jehovah proposes, and the people answer... But the covenant is made with man only through his reception of the influx of truth from the Divine, and then through correspondence. Explained.
To make a covenant with the wild beasts of the field, with bird, and with the reptile of the earth () = the conjunction of the Lord through the internal and external good and truth with man.
Hence that salt is called the salt of the covenant of thy God (); for covenant = conjunction; and salt = the desire for conjunction.
Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods () = no communication with evils and falsities. To make a covenant = to be conjoined; thus also to be communicated...
He took the Book of the Covenant () = the Word in the letter, with which is conjoined the Word in Heaven. Covenant = conjunction.

As by covenant is signified conjunction, and as by the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord... there is effected conjunction, all things which are of Divine truth from the Lord are called a covenant. Enumerated and Illustrated.
Behold, the blood of the covenant () = thereby conjunction of the Lord as to the Divine Human with Heaven and with earth. Covenant = conjunction.
The covenant of an age () = conjunction with the Lord to eternity.
Behold, I make a covenant () = the primary things through which there is the conjunction of the Lord with mankind through the Word. Covenant = conjunction.

Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land upon which thou comest () = that no adherence is to be given to any religion whatever in which there is evil. To make a covenant = to be conjoined; thus also to adhere to. AC 10647.

Upon the mouth of these words I make a covenant with thee and with Israel () = that thereby there is conjunction with those who are in external and internal worship... To make a covenant = conjunction.
A covenant for the people, and a light of the nations () = the Lord as to the Human.

As through this Law there is conjunction of the Lord with man, and of man with the Lord, it is called the covenant, and the testimony... DLife 60, Illustrated. DP 95:end. DP 326:7. TCR 285. AE 391:16.
Covenants are made for the sake of love, friendship, consociation; thus of conjunction.
Hence the conjunction of the Lord with the Church was represented by a covenant, such as there is between two who swear to a compact.
There is a table therein, on which is the inscription, the covenant between Jehovah and the Heavens.
As the Word is the medium of conjunction, it is called the covenant, Old and New.

It is with the Holy Supper as with a covenant, which, after the articles are settled, is agreed to, and finally signed and sealed. That the Lord's blood is a covenant, He Himself teaches... The new testament is the new covenant; therefore the Word written through the prophets before the coming of the Lord, is called the Old Testament or Covenant, while that written after His Coming by the evangelists and apostles, is called the New Testament or Covenant... The Word is the covenant itself which the Lord made with man, and man with the Lord; for the Lord descended as... the Divine truth; and as this is His Blood, in the Israelitish Church... blood was called the blood of the covenant (. ); and the Lord, the Covenant of the people (, etc.).
The Book of the covenant = the Divine truth through which there is conjunction.
Covenant = conjunction through love. AE 695:4.
When the Law is called a covenant, the Word is understood, through which there is conjunction.
Covenant = the truth of doctrine; testimony. the good of life according to truths of doctrine.
Covenant = conjunction with the Lord through love to Him.
A covenant of peace = conjunction with the Lord through the Divine things proceeding from Him...
I have made a covenant with Mine Elect () = the union of His Divine with the Human.
The covenant of life and peace () = the union of His Divine with the Human.
This reciprocal conjunction, of the Lord with man, and of man with the Lord... is what is meant by the covenant in the Word.

Covenant = conjunction with the Lord through the reception of Divine truth in the understanding and will... and this conjunction takes place reciprocally... for it is evident from the Word: 1. That the Lord Himself is called the covenant, because conjunction is effected by Himself with Himself through the Divine which proceeds from Himself. 2. That the Divine proceeding, which is the Divine truth, thus the Word, is the covenant, because it conjoins. 3. That the precepts, judgments, and statutes commanded to the Sons of Israel were a covenant to them, because thereby there was at that time conjunction with the Lord. 4. That, moreover, whatever conjoins is called a covenant. (All these points illustrated at great length.)
What is meant by the old covenant, and what by the new covenant. Explained. AE 701:20.
The covenant made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob was different. Explained, Illustrated.
As man is to desist from evils as of himself, the ten commandments were written on two tables, and these were called the covenant... AE 1027:end, Explained.
